scope: Static reverse engineering of exact AIO18 SkyrimUpscaler.dll and PDPerfPlugin.dll; no game/GPU execution.

feature_pool.behavior: releases excess slots, creates missing slots, recreates feature ownership when work dimensions/scale require it

release.qualification: The mapped release path invokes broader synchronization/ownership helpers before feature/resource destruction, but static analysis has not proved their exact fence-completion contract.

release_failure_concern.statement: Feature handles are discarded after ReleaseFeature is attempted even when diagnostics report failure; whether that leaks/retains vendor ownership after device loss requires runtime validation.
